title: HEROES, VILLAINS, AND VICTIMS, AND GPT-3 AUTOMATED EXTRACTION OF CHARACTER ROLES WITHOUT TRAINING DATA

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting character roles (hero, villain, and victim) from political speeches and news articles using zero-shot GPT-3 prompts, clustering the generated entities using S-BERT and k-means, and calculating the log odds ratio of the clusters based on the political party affiliation of the speaker or news outlet to measure partisan framing differences.
